meta.what: Buildings inside the study bbox whose recorded construction year is 2001 or earlier, as published today. This is the set that stood in 2001 AND still stands; buildings demolished since 2001 (including the seven World Trade Center buildings) are absent because the source only describes buildings that exist now.

frame.axes: x east, y up, z south (north is -z); same frame as the tower .glb files (paradata P-043)
frame.projection: local equirectangular about the origin: x = (lon - lon0) * cos(lat0) * R * pi / 180, z = -(lat - lat0) * R * pi / 180, R = 6378137 m (WGS84 semi-major axis). Error over a 1 km study area is well under a metre.
frame.y: not carried. ground_elevation_ft is kept per building but not applied; every building is extruded from y = 0 (paradata P-067).
frame.units_in: height_roof_ft and ground_elevation_ft are feet as published; the generator converts with 1 ft = 0.3048 m

origin.method: Area centroid of the quadrilateral whose corners are the junctions of the NYC Street Centerline segments for Church St, Vesey St, Liberty St and West St around the former superblock (the block the six original buildings and the plaza occupied). West St is a divided roadway in CSCL; the junction on its eastern carriageway, the one adjoining the block, is used. Street half-widths were not subtracted: the shift that would make is under 7 ft, and tower positions inside the block are unresolved anyway (paradata P-065, P-066).
origin.cross_check: 0 of 208 filtered footprints have a vertex inside the block quadrilateral

sources.name: Building Footprints (dataset title "BUILDING")
sources.publisher: NYC Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI), via NYC Open Data
notes: height_roof is the height of the CURRENT roof above the building's ground elevation (field documentation: 'The height of the roof above the ground elevation, not height above sea level'). It is not a 2001 measurement; a building altered since 2001 is shown at its present height.

construction_year is 'the year construction of the building was completed', originally from the Department of Finance RPAD file, later from imagery and city systems. Zero or null means unknown; such rows do not pass the filter and are absent.
The dataset contains only buildings that exist today. Buildings demolished after 2001 are not in it, so the context is incomplete by construction: a labeled gap, not an omission the model could fill.
Dataset 5zhs-2jue was republished on the new Socrata backend in 2024 with renamed fields (cnstrct_yr -> construction_year, heightroof -> height_roof, groundelev -> ground_elevation).

sources.name: NYC Street Centerline (CSCL)
sources.publisher: NYC Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI), via NYC Open Data
sources.filter: intersects(the_geom, 'POLYGON((-74.0165 40.7075, -74.0075 40.7075, -74.0075 40.7145, -74.0165 40.7145, -74.0165 40.7075))') AND full_street_name in ('CHURCH ST','VESEY ST','LIBERTY ST','WEST ST')
notes: Used only to locate the site origin (the block centroid). Current centerlines; the streets bounding the block keep their 2001 alignments, which is why they can locate it.
